title: test(showcase): the smoke's global setup declines the console's workspace prompt before any spec runs
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"marchtian"} -->
_Requested by **田騏** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSi?thread=cmsg_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSi9paTx1Lu8ENYwwssthfK3h)_

Fixes #29811

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：showcase 浏览器冒烟的 `e2e/global-setup.ts` 在所有用例开跑前，用控制台工作区提示框自己的「Not now」按钮把它关掉一次，只把提示框「已问过」的本机记录带进各用例共用的 storageState；没有改任何用例、断言、超时或产品代码。
- **为什么改**：#28953（`2ac698baf1`）让控制台在组织未设默认货币时弹出一个模态框询问管理员。showcase 的开发种子在主机未设区域/区域无国家时不写货币，于是夜间每个用例都撞上这个模态框：背后页面被标成 `aria-hidden`，按角色查找的三个用例（批量操作勾选框、Money 分组按钮、相关列表表格）找不到元素，夜间 live 层因此变红。
- **风险与回滚**：低。只动测试夹具；「Not now」不向工作区写任何东西，showcase 数据与金额显示保持原样；storageState 只多一条提示记录，不带入侧栏展开等其它状态。回滚即回退本 PR。
- **先看**：`examples/app-showcase/e2e/global-setup.ts`（`declineWorkspacePrompt` 及其返回的记录过滤）。
- **两分钟验证**：`cd examples/app-showcase && CI=1 SMOKE_API_URL=http://localhost:39111 npx playwright test e2e/bulk-capability-gate.spec.ts e2e/detail-shapes.spec.ts`，预期 4 passed。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

`examples/app-showcase/e2e/global-setup.ts` now answers the console's one-time workspace prompt once, before any spec runs:

- It reads `GET /api/settings/localization` with the signed-in admin's token and decides whether the console would ask, by the console's own condition per key (a timezone still the default and unlocked, or a currency resolving from the default with no value and unlocked). Nothing to ask ⇒ nothing is opened.
- Otherwise it opens the showcase app in a browser launched with the specs' own launch options (so `OS_TEST_CHROMIUM_EXECUTABLE_PATH` holds), waits for `workspace-timezone-prompt`, and presses `workspace-timezone-prompt-decline` ("Not now" / "Keep the default"). Declining writes nothing to the workspace.
- It takes ONLY the prompt's per-device record (`os:workspace-timezone-prompt:ORG:USER`) from that context's localStorage and adds it to the storageState it already wrote. The rest of what the console stored while open (the sidebar's wide-open flag, recent items, the active organization) is left out, so every spec still starts from the fresh-context layout it measures from; detail-shapes derives its 780 px window from a context with no stored sidebar state.
- A declined prompt that left no record throws, naming the cause, because every spec would meet the prompt again. A prompt the backend says would ask but the console never showed is a warning, as in `ui/e2e/live/global-setup.ts`, which already answers the same prompt for the console's own live suite.

No spec, assertion, timeout or product file changes.

### Root cause, per failing test

All three reds have one cause: `2ac698baf1` (#28953, card #28872, "the workspace prompt also asks an administrator for a still-unset default currency"), which landed between the last green nightly (`494c7435f8`, run 41394734666) and the red one (`339f63da30`, run 41584589032). `git merge-base --is-ancestor 2ac698baf1`: not an ancestor of `494c7435f8` (exit 1; control leg on the same shallow checkout: `65a8d4ffb1` = `494c7435f8~3`, deeper than the tested commit, exit 0), an ancestor of `339f63da30` (exit 0). The same commit taught `ui/e2e/live/global-setup.ts` to answer the prompt; the showcase smoke's global setup was not taught.

The page snapshot of each failure (local reproduction at `4b71a82b76`) shows `dialog: heading "Set the default currency"` with the console behind it `aria-hidden`:

1. `bulk-capability-gate.spec.ts:38`: `getByRole('checkbox').first()` resolves, then the click waits behind the modal overlay until the 45 s test timeout.
2. `detail-shapes.spec.ts:95`: `getByRole('button', { name: 'Money' })` excludes the `aria-hidden` subtree, so "Money header icon svg" is not found. The icon itself renders.
3. `detail-shapes.spec.ts:161`: `getByRole('table')` inside the details column is excluded for the same reason, so `INV-1002` is not found.

The product change is intended, so the specs stay as they are and the harness answers the prompt the way a person would.

## Tests

- Reproduced red at base `4b71a82b76`: the two spec files, `--retries=0`, gave 3 failed and 1 passed, with the same three tests and the same errors as the nightly.
- Green on head, three consecutive runs of the same two files (`--retries=0`, `CI=1`, a free port each run): 4 passed, 4 passed, 4 passed. After each run the storageState held exactly `auth-session-token` and the prompt record.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/example-showcase typecheck`: exit 0 (its tsconfig includes `e2e/**/*`).
- eslint `--no-inline-config` on the changed file: exit 0.

## Acceptance notes

- The other 51 tests in `showcase-smoke.spec.ts` stayed green on the red night with the same modal over every surface they opened. A "renders cleanly" check that a modal over the whole page does not disturb is weaker than its name. Noted here only; no card.
- Answering with "Not now" keeps the showcase as seeded. The prompt's confirm arm (writing the browser region's currency) is not exercised by this smoke, as before.
- No changeset: `@objectstack/example-showcase` is private and the diff is an e2e fixture. Labelled `skip-changeset`.

## Verification

<details><summary>Derived gates</summary>

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`: 32 commands for the 1 changed path. Each one was run with its exit code captured before any pipe: 31 exit 0, and `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exit 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET: some packages had no `dist/` in this worktree, so nothing was measured; CI's Lint & Repo Gates runs it). `--ran` reconciliation: 32 derived families accounted for, 31 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.

</details>

<details><summary>Full showcase live test</summary>

`OS_TEST_TIERS=nightly pnpm --filter @objectstack/example-showcase test` under the verify lock, twice on head `835ac408b2` (main `4b71a82b76`), Console and the showcase's dependency closure built at that tree:

- `test/showcase-smoke.live.test.ts` (this card's file): passed both times, Playwright `54 passed`.
- `test/console-live-specs.live.test.ts`: failed both times on ONE spec of `ui/e2e/live/`, `record-history-display.spec.ts:56` ("the timeline stream's Changes chip shows display values"). The Owner and Customer Since change lines render as field names with no values, so `Live E2E showcase_manager` is not found. That file passed on the red nightly at `339f63da30`, and it boots its own backend and its own global setup (`ui/e2e/live/global-setup.ts`), which this diff does not touch. So the package command exited 1 (lock VERDICT `command-exit 1`, twice). The cause is not attributed here; it is reported to the seat as a finding outside this card.


</details>
